correspondences.notes: No BIDS 1.11.2 suffix for SNR maps.

brainlife.desc: Experimental per-voxel signal-to-noise map (NIfTI), e.g. brain-masked temporal SNR of DWI b0 volumes.
brainlife.name: neuro/snr
brainlife.readme:
EDIT ME

**Use for:** DWI data-quality checks.

**Not for:** Comparing across sites without matching the SNR definition (tag tSNR).

**BIDS:** no BIDS counterpart.

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** output of 1 App.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.snr.json

identifying_risks: Rows or file names may carry subject and session codes
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level data-quality measures without direct identifiers; they reveal little about the person.
sharing_cautions: Use coded subject IDs and drop dates
tier_conditions: Tier 1 once reduced to group statistics with no participant rows

not_suitable_for: Comparing across sites without matching the SNR definition (tag tSNR).

outputs_of.name: Compute  tSNR of DMRI Images
outputs_of.purpose: tSNR map from DWI b0 volumes
